answer: Marble-ledger sponsor-decay bond: a new identity needs a sponsor staking 60 credits, 20 reputation on a public marble ledger, max three per sponsor. It tends a yarrow plot and files a plume reading per epoch; auditors check it on the ledger, and a fake plot burns it. Cheating costs the sponsor 60 and 20 reputation, decaying 10 per bad epoch; 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and 20,040 credits. Honest identities pay 30 once, keep their sponsor.
